verdict.rationale: Semgrep Secrets is documented to scan code for exposed API keys, passwords, and credentials, including validating whether secrets are live (semgrep-docs-8, semgrep-docs-9, semgrep-docs-10), and pre-commit hooks are noted as a way to prevent secrets from 'leaking into your Git history' (semgrep-docs-16). However, all documentation describes scanning the current codebase/working tree, not scanning full git commit history for previously-committed secrets — a capability more associated with dedicated tools like gitleaks/trufflehog, and no evidence pack item confirms Semgrep traverses git history.
